violations.text: ROP crab meat was observed thawing with ROP packaging still intact. Crab meat was observed at 35 DF and was completely taken out of package at the time of inspection. Proper thawing methods reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2026

Both doors to the outside, located in the kitchen, are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026
Salad prep unit and cook line prep unit was observed non-operational and in poor repair. Per PIC, parts are on order. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the mixer have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2026

The storage closet in the basement area has an accumulation of soil residue, droppings, and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the ware washing area and grill line do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2026
Allergen statement is lacking on menu. Establishment is to add an allergen statement to menu. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026

Molluscan Shellfish clams located in walk-in cooler did not have the proper identification tags. Molluscan Shellstock tags must remain attached to the container in which the Molluscan Shellstock are received until the container is empty. Tag was placed with product at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwashers at the bar and kitchen were 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment is to sanitize all dishes in the 3-bay sink until the dishwashers are able to reach the proper chlorine sanitizing solution. 3-bay sink was set-up at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils slicer, and veggie chopper were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Establishment is not to use slicer and vegie chopper until they are properly cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

Various food was observed held between 45-54 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, prep unit was turned off to clean 2 hours prior to inspection and stocked 1 hour prior to inspection. All food in prep unit was moved to walk-in cooler at the time of inspection. Establishment is not to store any TCS foods in prep unit until it is able to maintain an internal food temperature of 41 DF or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

The presence of fruit flies is not controlled as evidenced by live activity. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to continue to work with pest control and follow pest control recommendations to eliminate pests. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

Both doors to the outside, located in the kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026

The following equipment was observed in poor repair. -Walk-in freezer -Salad prep unit (not maintaining an ambient of 41 DF) -Prep unit on the line (not maintaining an ambient of 41 DF) Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. -Ice machine -Walk-in fans -Refrigeration units -Mixer -Kitchen fan Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.Along the floors and storage closet in the basement area has an accumulation of soil residue, droppings, and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.The floor in the basement area has an accumulation stagnant. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Establishment is to clean/remove all stagnant water. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the ware washing area and grill line do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2026

The door to the outside, located in the kitchen & basement, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2025

The cutting boards in the kitchen are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. 1. Fan 2. Hoods 3. Rinse Knozle New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2025

The floor and wall junctures in the ware-washing area do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2025

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink at the bar. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2025
The hand-washing sink in the bar was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2025

Dishes and utensils were observed in the hand-washing sink at the bar. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2025

Molluscan Shellfish (clams) located in (walk-in cooler) did not have the proper identification tags. Molluscan Shellstock tags must remain attached to the container in which the Molluscan Shellstock are received until the container is empty. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2025

Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination. Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2025

Cut iceberg was observed held at 52 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. See disposal. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2025
Cheese was observed past date of disposition. Cheese was voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2025

Cheese was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2025

The door to the outside, located in the kitchen & basement, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2025
Single service items were observed stored on the floor in the basement. Single service items must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2025
Prep unit was not in good repair, ambient was 50F. PIC took unit out of service at time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2025

The cutting boards in the kitchen are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. 1. Knife rack 2. Rinse knozle 3. Flat top (sides) 4. Hoods 5. Shelving in kitchen 6. Fan (ware washing area) New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2025
